title: Formal Foundations for Known Good Reliable Die Screening in Chiplet-Based AI Systems-on-Chip
event_hint: KGRD (Known Good Reliable Die) formal screening methodology for chiplet-based AI SoCs
problem: Conventional Known Good Die (KGD) screening guarantees pre-assembly functional correctness but offers no probabilistic assurance of post-assembly reliability lifetime for expensive chiplet-based AI SoCs
mechanism: Bayesian probabilistic risk model with quantified observability bias bound, safety-gated decision architecture with provable post-assembly failure probability guarantee, Bayes-optimal disposition thresholds, and constrained closed-loop feedback

evidence.claim: Monte Carlo simulation on N=4,000 synthetic dies verifies four theoretical properties
evidence.condition: Monte Carlo simulation on synthetic dies

evidence.claim: Parameter error reduced by 42% from 1.35 to 0.78
evidence.condition: Constrained MAP update for T=20 iterations with 200 cumulative dies per iteration

evidence.claim: Safety-compliant fraction remains above 98% at every iteration

evaluation_context: Monte Carlo simulation study on N=4,000 synthetic dies; no real silicon, fabrication process, or production data
limitations: Simulation-only validation; no experimental results on actual ATE/PTE fab data across multiple foundries and packaging technologies; treats package context vector as fixed and fully known; treats dies independently ignoring thermal/mechanical coupling in 2.5D/3D packages; uses logistic model which may miss nonlinear interactions
project_relevance: Topic alignment confirmed (AI芯片与加速器: chiplet/先进封装/KGRD screening). This is a formal/theoretical contribution establishing mathematical foundations for chiplet reliability screening, not an architecture or performance paper. Value is in establishing post-assembly reliability probability guarantees with quantified observability bias bounds—relevant for chiplet-based AI SoC yield and cost modeling. No实测算力、带宽、功耗 data; focus shifts from functional correctness (KGD) to reliability lifetime (KGRD) screening under incomplete pre-assembly observability.
